mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate sympathomimetic effects; bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) which increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias and hypertensive crisis, and loop diuretics can enhance MAOI-related hypotension or hypertension depending on sympathomimetic exposure.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, monitor blood pressure closely, assess electrolytes regularly, and educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction and sympathomimetic avoidance.
